title: Three Weeks and One Short Bin
subtitle: 污染治理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 污染治理（人与自然·环境保护·污染与治理）
meta: 主题语境：污染治理（人与自然·环境保护·污染与治理）　|　核心词汇：garbage　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 garbage 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the collector ① collected the garbage that no inspector in the lane would have weighed, and he said the collecting was the whole of the morning. The ② garbage, meaning the waste itself and not the leaves, ran three weeks and stayed unweighed in the book; garbage, he said, is the only thing in a lane that is judged by how long it is left unweighed.

Every ③ bag of garbage in that lane had the same short bin beside it, and the ④ garbage at the far corner, meaning the pile they kept for the children to sort and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Garbage, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to weigh; the collector said the weighing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the garbage was the whole of the matter, meaning the nonsense and not the waste. The ⑥ garbage, meaning the nonsense and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody weighs; garbage, he said, is either something you collect or the only word that means both waste and a nonsense. He said the nonsense is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ garbage had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short bin. The ⑧ garbage of the whole thing, the collector wrote in November, was one lane and three weeks of weighing; garbage, he said, is either the pile at the far corner or the reason you learned to weigh. He said the weighing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ garbage I remember is the garbage weighed in the plan, which closed in 1978 and is still weighed as the quietest in the lane. ⑩ Garbage, my mother said in 1980, is the only thing that improves by being weighed; all garbage, she said, is a nonsense that has agreed to look like waste. She said the nonsense was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 垃圾（指巷子里每一袋旁边的那一袋）
B. n. 垃圾（指那些垃圾本身，与落叶相对）
C. 固定搭配：collect the garbage 收走垃圾

F. n. 垃圾（指清运单里写到、被称过的那些）

items.q: collected the garbage that no inspector in the lane would have weighed

answers.why: collect the garbage 意为“收走垃圾”，1971 年那位清洁工收走了巷子里没有一位检查员肯过秤的垃圾。
garbage 意为“垃圾”，指那些垃圾本身而不是落叶，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被过秤。
garbage 意为“垃圾”，指巷子里每一袋旁边的那一袋，每一袋旁边都有同一只矮矮的垃圾桶。
garbage 意为“垃圾”，指最远角落留给孩子们分类的那堆，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
garbage 意为“废话、胡说”，指一件事里人人都听却无人当真的那样东西，叔叔说这些废话就是那件事的全部。
garbage 意为“废话”，指人人都听却无人当真的那样东西而不是那些垃圾，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
garbage 意为“垃圾”，指清运单里写到、被称过的那些，到 1976 年这些成了计划里的一行。
garbage 意为“垃圾”，清洁工十一月写道，整件事的垃圾之事是一条巷子和三个星期的过秤。
garbage 意为“垃圾”，我记得的是计划里称过的那些，1978 年清运完了，至今仍被说成巷子里最安静的一堆。
garbage 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，垃圾是唯一会因为被好好过秤而变得更好的东西。
